methodologyNotes: Roster covers thirteen track (plunge-cut guide-rail) saws spanning budget corded models to premium corded and 18V/36V/60V-MAX cordless systems, verified 2026-08-05 primarily against manufacturer pages (Festool, Makita, Kreg, DeWalt, Milwaukee, Bosch, WEN, Metabo) with retailer corroboration (Rockler, Woodcraft, Toolnut, Acme Tools, Zoro, Walmart) where manufacturer sites omit pricing or a spec. Two corrections were made to the seed list. (1) The seed 'Grizzly T31635' is not a track saw -- that model number resolves to a 12 in. dual-bevel sliding compound miter saw (confirmed via FineWoodworking review and Grizzly's own miter-saw manual). It was replaced with Grizzly's actual current track saw, the Grizzly PRO T33300 (6-1/4 in., tool-only). grizzly.com blocks automated fetches (403/CloudFront) and no other retailer page for the T33300 SKU could be retrieved within accessible sources, so beyond blade diameter and product identity (confirmed via search-result page titles/snippets referencing the live grizzly.com listing) its numeric specs and price are left null rather than guessed. (2) 'Metabo KT 66' (corded KT 66 BL) is documented on Metabo's global/EU site and sold through EU distributors (e.g. MisterWorker, Italy) in EUR; no US-market listing could be confirmed -- Metabo's US operation (metabo.com/us) markets the cordless KT 18 LTX 66 BL counterpart instead. The corded KT 66 BL entry is retained (it is a real, current Metabo product a US buyer could special-order/import) with EU-sourced specs and priceUsd left null rather than currency-converting a non-US list price. Several current-generation SKUs differ from older seed names Festool has since superseded on its own site (TS 55 REQ -> TS 55 FEQ-F-Plus SKU 576708); these are documented under the SKU Festool currently sells, per its own product page. no_load_rpm is recorded as the full documented variable-speed range (a string) where a range is published, or a single top-speed figure where only one number is documented. included_rail_length_in is null for every bare-saw/no-rail kit variant researched (all 13 entries) -- guide rails for these saws are sold as separate accessories/kits in the US market and none of the specific SKUs priced here ships with a rail in the box.

products.name: Festool TS 55 FEQ-F-Plus 6-1/4" Plunge-Cut Track Saw (current SKU for TS 55 REQ)
products.priceNote: Current Rockler retail (SKU 576708); Festool does not display consumer pricing on festoolusa.com.
products.provenance: Festool's current US product page (SKU 576708, titled TS 55 FEQ-F-Plus) confirms 160mm/6-1/4in blade, 0-55mm (0-2-1/8in) cutting depth at 90 deg, 1200W at 120VAC, 2000-5800 no-load RPM, -1 to 47 deg bevel, and 4.8kg (10.58 lb) weight. CORRECTED FROM SEED: the seed name 'TS 55 REQ' (older SKUs 575387/576011) has been superseded on Festool's own current site by the TS 55 FEQ-F-Plus -- same saw family, updated electronics -- documented under the SKU Festool actually sells today. Price $669.00 confirmed on Rockler's product page (same core saw, listed under the 576011 URL slug). No amperage figure is published for the US 120V unit (only wattage), so motor_amps is null. This bare-tool SKU does not ship with a guide rail (rail sold separately or via '-FS' kit SKUs), so included_rail_length_in is null.

products.name: Festool TS 75 EQ-F-Plus 8-1/4" Plunge-Cut Track Saw
products.priceNote: Woodcraft current retail (SKU 576118); Rockler lists the same SKU at $979.00. Festool does not display consumer pricing directly on festoolusa.com.
products.provenance: Festool's official TS 75 EQ-F-Plus page confirms 210mm/8-1/4in blade, 0-75mm (0-3in) cutting depth at 90 deg, 55mm (2-1/8in) at 45 deg, 1600W at 120VAC, 1350-4400 no-load RPM, 0-47 deg bevel, and 10.30kg (22.7 lb) weight with accessories. Retailer prices vary widely by kit/bundle ($799 Woodcraft vs $979 Rockler for the same base SKU 576118); no amperage figure is published (wattage only), so motor_amps is null. No verifiable manufacturer or retailer product-image URL could be extracted from the fetched pages, so the image field is omitted rather than guessed.

products.name: Makita SP6000J 6-1/2" Plunge Circular Saw
products.priceNote: Current Rockler retail; Makita does not display consumer pricing on makitatools.com.
products.provenance: Makita's official SP6000J page confirms 6-1/2in blade, 2-3/16in cutting depth at 90 deg, 1-9/16in at 45 deg, 12A/1800W motor, 2000-5200 no-load RPM (variable speed), -1 to 48 deg bevel (positive stops at 22.5/45), and 9.7 lb weight; 20mm arbor and 48-tooth included blade also confirmed. Price $519.00 from Rockler as Makita's own site shows no consumer price. Sold as a bare saw (no guide rail in box); Makita sells compatible rails separately.

products.name: Makita XPS01PTJ 18V X2 LXT (36V) Brushless 6-1/2" Cordless Plunge Circular Saw Kit
products.priceNote: Current Acme Tools retail for the XPS01PTJ kit (2 batteries + dual-port charger); promotional pricing as low as $549 has been seen. Makita does not display consumer pricing on makitatools.com.
products.provenance: Makita's official XPS01PTJ page (the seed 'XPS01' bare-tool designation XPS01Z is sold only inside kits like this PTJ SKU in the US) confirms 6-1/2in blade, 2-3/16in/1-9/16in cutting depth at 90/45 deg, 36V (18Vx2 LXT) brushless motor, 2500-6300 no-load RPM, -1 to 48 deg bevel, and 11.2 lb weight. No amperage/wattage is published for a battery-driven motor, so those fields are null. Ships without a guide rail (39in/55in/118in rails sold separately); some retailers bundle a rail (e.g. Acme Tools' 55in-rail bundle SKU), which is a separate listing from the bare XPS01PTJ kit priced here.

products.name: Kreg Adaptive Cutting System ACS-SAWBB Plunge-Cut Track Saw
products.provenance: CORRECTED/UPDATED FROM SEED: the seed 'ACS-SAW' bare-saw SKU is now sold by Kreg as ACS-SAWBB (48-tooth carbide blade included); documented under the current SKU. Kreg's own product page confirms $349.99 price, 2-1/8in max cut depth at 90 deg, 1-1/2in at 45 deg, 12A variable-speed motor with electronic blade brake, and -1 to 47 deg bevel; the page's own marketing copy states a single '6000rpm' top speed figure that conflicts with the 2000-5500 no-load range independently corroborated across multiple retailer spec sheets (Beaver Tools, The Power Tool Store) reproducing Kreg's underlying spec sheet -- the corroborated 2000-5500 range is used here. Blade diameter (6-1/2in) and weight are not stated on Kreg's own page; blade diameter is taken from consistent retailer-listing corroboration, weight is left null as no source stated it. Sold without the 62in Guide Track (sold separately or in the ACS2100 bundle), so included_rail_length_in is null.

products.name: DeWalt DWS520K 6-1/2" (165mm) Heavy-Duty Corded Track Saw Kit
products.priceNote: Current Tool Nut retail; DeWalt does not display consumer pricing directly on dewalt.com.
products.provenance: DeWalt's official product page confirms 6-1/2in blade, 2-1/8in cutting depth at 90 deg, 1-5/8in at 45 deg, 12A/1300W/120V brushed corded motor, and that the kit ships as a bare no-rail kit-box set (48-tooth blade, wrench, kit box). No-load RPM (1400-4000) and weight (11.5 lb) are not shown on DeWalt's own page and are taken from distributor spec-sheet echoes (GovPlanet/PartsSource) reproducing the manufacturer's published rating plate data. Bevel range is not stated on any fetched source, so it is left null rather than assumed from the sibling DCS520 (0-47 deg), since DeWalt does not confirm the two share identical bevel hardware. Price $574.99 at Tool Nut.

products.name: DeWalt DCS520T1 60V MAX FlexVolt Brushless Cordless 6-1/2" Track Saw Kit
products.priceNote: DCS520T1 kit (saw + one 6.0Ah FlexVolt battery + charger + kit box, no rail) MSRP per contractor/trade press coverage (Contractor Supply Magazine, Tool Box Buzz). Also sold bare as DCS520B ($379 MSRP) and with a 59in track as DCS520ST1 ($579 MSRP).
products.provenance: DeWalt's official DCS520T1 page confirms 6-1/2in (165mm) blade and on-track cut depth of 2-1/8in at 90 deg / 1-5/8in at 45 deg, 60V MAX FlexVolt battery power, and brushless motor with straight-plunge mechanism. No-load RPM (1750-4000), bevel range (0-47 deg), and weight (12.5 lb) are not exposed in DeWalt's own page markup (JS-rendered spec table) and are taken from Tool Box Buzz's hands-on preview and ToolUp's listed spec sheet, both reproducing DeWalt's press-kit figures. Kit MSRP figures ($379/$499/$579 across DCS520B/T1/ST1) corroborated identically across Contractor Supply Magazine and Tool Box Buzz coverage. Ships without a track (DCS520ST1 is the track-included variant), so included_rail_length_in is null for the T1 kit priced here.

products.name: Milwaukee M18 FUEL 2831-21 6-1/2" Plunge Track Saw Kit
products.priceNote: Kit price (saw + 6.0Ah High Output battery + charger + Packout XL toolbox); bare tool (2831-20) lists around $399. Milwaukee does not display consumer pricing directly on milwaukeetool.com.
products.provenance: Milwaukee's official M18 FUEL 2831-21 page confirms 6-1/2in blade, POWERSTATE brushless motor with 5,600 RPM top no-load speed, 0/22.5/45 deg positive bevel stops, 90%+ dust collection, and M18 REDLITHIUM HIGH OUTPUT XC6.0 battery/PACKOUT XL kit contents. The 2,500 RPM low end of the variable-speed dial range, 2-1/4in max cutting depth at 90 deg, 9.13 lb bare-tool weight, and $687 kit price are corroborated across Tool Nut, Amazon, and Red Tool Store listings reproducing Milwaukee's spec sheet (some secondary sources cite a 6,300 RPM motor-shaft figure distinct from the 5,600 RPM blade no-load spec; the blade-spec figure is used here). No 45 deg cutting-depth figure was located on any fetched source, so it is left null rather than assumed.

products.name: Bosch GKT13-225L 6-1/2" Corded Track Saw with Plunge Action and L-BOXX Case
products.priceNote: Zoro industrial-distributor list price (accessed 2026-08-05); Bosch does not display consumer MSRP on boschtools.com. Home Depot and other big-box/pro retailers also list this SKU but their product pages block automated access, so a lower confirmed street price could not be independently retrieved within accessible sources.
products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED NAMING: the seed 'Bosch GKT13-225' corresponds to the current retail SKU GKT13-225L (the 'L' denotes the included L-BOXX carrying case; this is the only GKT13-225 variant Bosch currently sells in the US) -- documented under that SKU. Zoro's structured product data confirms 6-1/2in blade, 13A/120V/60Hz, 13/16in arbor, 0-47 deg bevel (right), 2-1/4in cutting depth at 90 deg, 1-13/20in (~1.65in) at 45 deg, 6,250 RPM max blade speed, 10.4 lb tool weight, and that no track is included in the box. Bosch's own product page (boschtools.com) independently confirms the 3,600-6,250 RPM variable-speed range and constant-response electronics. Zoro's $755.00 list price is an industrial-distributor figure; Home Depot's consumer listing (which appears in search results at a materially different price point) could not be fetched directly due to bot-blocking, so it is cited only as an unconfirmed corroboration rather than used as the priced figure.

products.name: Triton TTS1400 6-1/2" 1400W Plunge Track Saw
products.priceNote: Current Walmart.com retail; Triton's own site (tritontools.com) does not display US consumer pricing in the fetched region.
products.provenance: Retailer listing copy (Walmart, corroborated by Amazon and Toolnut, all reproducing Triton's manufacturer spec sheet) confirms 165mm/6-1/2in blade, 1400W/12A/120V motor, 54mm/2-1/8in max cut depth at 90 deg, 2000-5300 no-load RPM, 0-48 deg bevel, and a 60-tooth TCT blade included. No 45 deg cutting-depth figure or weight was located on any fetched source, so both are left null rather than assumed. Triton's own product page (tritontools.com) returned a 404/region-redirect on direct fetch, so this entry relies on retailer-reproduced spec data rather than a first-party manufacturer page. No verifiable product image URL could be extracted from the fetched pages, so the image field is omitted.

products.name: WEN CT1065 10-Amp 6.5-Inch Plunge Cut Sidewinder Circular Track Saw
products.priceNote: Current direct price on wenproducts.com; frequently discounted to $84-$95 at Amazon, Walmart, and Lowe's.
products.provenance: WEN's own product page confirms a 10A motor spinning the 6.5in (24-tooth carbide, 20mm arbor) blade up to 5500 RPM, an adjustable depth gauge to 2-1/3in (2.33in) cut capacity, 45 deg left-only bevel (up to 1-5/8in thick stock), and a 12in x 6-5/8in base riding WEN's own track (guide rail sold separately as the CT9502 100in rail, confirming this base kit does not include a rail). Shopify product-variant JSON on the page lists shipping weight as 6160g (13.58 lb), which may include minor packaging weight rather than pure tool weight; no separate net-weight figure was found. Direct wenproducts.com price is $121.81; third-party retailers (Amazon/Walmart/Home Depot) commonly list $84-95, both figures noted.

products.priceNote: No confirmed US retail listing found. Metabo's AC/corded KT 66 BL is documented on Metabo's global site and sold through EU distributors (e.g. MisterWorker, Italy) in EUR; not currency-converted per no-guessing policy. Metabo's US storefront (metabo.com/us) markets the cordless KT 18 LTX 66 BL counterpart instead -- the corded KT 66 BL could not be confirmed as stocked by any US dealer within accessible sources.

This is the EU/global-market 220-240V specification; a US 120V variant could not be confirmed to exist or be sold, so voltage_v (230) and priceUsd (null) both reflect the EU-market reality rather than an assumed US equivalent. No verifiable manufacturer or retailer product-image URL could be extracted from the fetched pages, so the image field is omitted.
